ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this content block. This does not display to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

TitleVisible.helper: Turn off when the page already has an equivalent visible title.

TitleText.helper: Shown in the compact title/header section above the hero.

TitleHeadingLevel.helper: Choose the semantic heading level for the top title.

TitleSectionBackgroundColor.helper: Shown behind the compact title section. Enter a six-digit hex color such as #f5f5f5.

TitleSectionTextColor.helper: Used for the compact title section title text. Enter a six-digit hex text color such as #000000.

HeroHeading.helper: Main heading shown over the hero background.

HeroHeadingLevel.helper: Choose the semantic heading level for the hero heading.

HeroSubHeading.helper: Optional supporting line shown between the hero heading and body copy.

HeroSubHeadingLevel.helper: Choose the semantic heading level for the hero sub-heading.

HeroBody.helper: Body copy shown under the hero heading. HTML is allowed.
HeroBody.placeholder: Use this area to introduce the page, explain the main value, and guide visitors toward the next step.

BackgroundMediaType.helper: Controls which media fields are shown in this content form and which background media renders.

BackgroundColor.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Background Color. Enter a six-digit hex color such as #ffffff.

BackgroundColorTextColor.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Background Color. Enter a six-digit hex text color such as #000000.

HeroBackgroundImage.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Image. Wide landscape image used behind the hero. Recommended minimum: 1920 x 1000 px.

BackgroundPosition.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Image. CSS background-position for the hero image.

BackgroundSize.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Image. CSS background-size for the hero image.

BackgroundRepeat.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Image. CSS background-repeat for the hero image.

EnableParallax.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Image. When enabled, uses CSS-only fixed background parallax on desktop. The effect is disabled on mobile and for reduced-motion users.

VideoSourceType.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Video. Choose Auto Detect unless you need to force the URL to be treated as a regular video file or as YouTube.

VideoUrl.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Video. Desktop source video. Local paths, external video file URLs, and YouTube URLs are supported.

MobileTabletVideoUrl.helper: Optional. Used when Background Media Type is Video. Mobile and tablet-friendly source video. If empty, the desktop video is used on all screen sizes.

VideoDisplayMode.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Video. Crop to Fill works best for hero backgrounds; Fit Whole Video may create empty space; Stretch to Fill can distort the video.

VideoPosition.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Video. Controls which part of the video remains visible when cropped.

VideoPlaybackMode.helper: Used when Background Media Type is Video. Controls whether the background video loops or stops when it reaches the end.

SectionAriaLabel.helper: Optional. Adds an accessible label to the hero section. If blank, the hero heading labels the section.
